NEW: The Misty Swamp opens Friday, October 30! Tap Notify Me under Events.

🦖 Welcome to Dino Park! 🦖

Dig up fossils, bring dinosaurs back to life and build the dino park of your dreams! Professor Amber needs your help.

[How to Play]
⛏️ Dig for bones on 5 wild islands, from Sunset Badlands to Frostbite Peaks
🦴 Find every bone, then rebuild the skeleton in Professor Amber's lab
🥚 Keep your egg warm and watch your baby dino hatch
🌿 Give your dinos plants, food, water and toys so they grow big and happy
🏞️ Build paddocks, fences and lamps, and watch visitors come to your park

[Collect]
🦕 21 dinosaurs to find, from Triceratops to the mighty T. rex
⭐ Stickers, fun dino facts and your own park name and badge

[Play Together]
🤝 Join a Big Dig with everyone in the server
🏡 Visit a friend's park and help with their dinos

[Park Shop]
⚡ 2x boosts make things faster. Everything can be earned by playing. Nothing random.

👍 Like the game and join TryItHaveFun Inc. for updates!
